# Study 042: Professor Zei, Anthropologist, read against jaws-v1 (1-for-1, 10,000 paired games, Holm)
**Recommendation: NO CHANGE, but closest of the three.** For Faerie Mastermind it is a genuine trade, not a clear upgrade. If the pilot wants a Human/wheel slot, Zei for Mastermind is the only one of the nine screens worth arguing.
- for Faerie Mastermind: wheels by T10 1.94 -> 2.11 (+0.17 [+0.15, +0.18] Better), finisher wheel by T8 +1.2 pts [+0.9, +1.5] Better, hoard @T10 +0.70 [+0.50, +0.90] Better, cards seen by T5 +0.1 Better, missed drop -0.4 pts Better. Against: killed by T6 -0.4 pts [-0.6, -0.3] Worse, stall +1.2 pts [+1.0, +1.4] Worse, board power @T6 -0.1 Worse. damage @T10 -1.0 [-4.0, +2.0] no call. 6 better, 4 worse.
- for Willie Lumpkin: wheels +0.16 Better, finisher wheel +0.5 pts Better, but damage @T10 -4.2 [-6.9, -1.5] Worse, stall +1.0 pts Worse, extra cards -0.2 Worse. 2 better, 6 worse.
- for Brainstorm: wheels +0.16 Better, damage @T10 -3.0 [-6.4, +0.4] no call, killed by T6 -0.8 pts [-1.1, -0.6] Worse, extra cards -0.4 Worse. 2 better, 6 worse.
- Why it is the best of the three: it is 2 mana, and the regrow turns a spent Windfall or Wheel into a second one. That is the multiplier the branch lost when it cut six wheels. Why it is not clear: no damage gain on any cut, kill by T6 worse on all three, and the loot is card-neutral.
- The goldfish is blind to regrowing non-wheel spells (a Swords, a Counterspell, Akroma's Will back), so this is a floor. It also cannot see Mastermind's flash 2/1 flying blocker or Zei's 0/3 ground blocker. Mastermind's is the bigger defensive loss.
- Combo check: Mind Over Matter is not in the branch (grep: 0). Zei sacrifices himself, so there is no loop without it.
- The skeleton rows (S-aa604eaf-07..13) are branch vs sleeved, not this card, so they are ignored.
